Name: Slightly Recolored Weapons
Author: skellady
Description:
These are recolored weapons to make them look softer!  All in-game weapons were recolored except for unobtainable weapons. 

[size=5]Installation:﻿
[/size]
1. Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI 
[/url]2. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher﻿[/url]
3. Install the mod (manual download is recommended over vortex/mod managers)
4. Unzip the file, place the folder in your Mods folder
5. Launch your game and enjoy! 

[size=5]Config:
[/size]
- By default, both the normal scythe and the golden scythe will be recolored. To toggle them off, edit the config.json (available once you launch the game at least once). 

Allowed values: 
- For the golden scythe, change "GRecolor" to "GVanilla"
- For the normal scythe, change "Recolor" to "Vanilla"

[size=5]Extra:

[/size]- Interface used in the screenshot is [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8142]LOE's Interface[/url].
- Tools are now recolored to match the weapons! You can download them [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8736/]here[/url].


This is my first time making a CP mod so if anything's missing/looking off let me know! :D
